title: The shape of tissue
desc: Where cells sit in a slide of liver, read at every scale at once: balls grow round the cells, pieces join and loops open and close. From 123 slides, a classifier learns which scales tell cirrhosis from healthy tissue, and maps it back onto every cell.
page: The shape of tissue: topology of cells in the liver
sub: Topology of cells in the liver
aria: Interactive 3D story of how the arrangement of cells in liver tissue is read at every scale with persistent homology, and how it tells cirrhosis from healthy tissue
